stations.title: Kofi
stations.say: Can people book from the page?

stations.title: Classes page
stations.text: Book a place, then lines of words to read.

captions: Kofi wants people to book a class from the page, without ringing him.
The page says Book a place, but there is nothing to type into.
You add a form with three fields, a label for each, limits and a button.
A visitor types a name, an email and two places, and the booking is ready to send.
The timetable says when. Now the same page asks for the booking.
